task: FDD-012 (Subsidiary Management Plan Standards and Content Contracts): approve, reject, or request revision

criteria.description: Sections 3.1 to 3.7 implement BRU-012-01 to BRU-012-08 and ADR-012 sections 4.2 to 4.5: the grammar rule by rule (ADR-034 4.3.1), the closed metadata checks, the measured word count and heading regexes, the boundary rule, and the precedence and next-step table including 2 retries, human text kept and stub or mock escalated at once. The nine-plan table equals ADR-012 section 4.4.

The new package src/agent_learning/pmbok/ is pure (standard library only, no I/O, no storage), as ADR-034 section 4.3 names; the legacy top-level pmbok/ directory is not imported; tailoring is reused, not changed; no record type is added.

The FDD makes eight readings that ADR-012 does not state verbatim (flag code spelling, fail closed, extra keys, table agreement as Tier B, policy match scope, out-of-scope detection, EXCEEDS_PLAN_CAP carried to approval, equal to floor or cap). They are disclosed in section 6 for the maintainer to confirm, not hidden.
Nothing existing changes: tailoring.PlanRoute, Route and compute_flags are used as they are, and agent_learning/__init__.py only gains exports. The two Tier scales are always written out in full.
